from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its key identifying fields."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The official cause of action/案由 as stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The case classification: 民事，刑事，or 行政")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt anchoring the cause of action and case type")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
